tools.description: List FigCraft commands: id, label, menu path, shortcut, whether it is undoable, and a parameter description. Every menu item, panel action and shortcut is a command; run one with run_command (or several as one undo step with batch). Most commands act on `ids` when given, else on the selection. Use `filter` to narrow (e.g. "align", "layout", "variable", "style", "component", "proto").

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against id, label, menu path and parameter docs

tools.name: list_commands
tools.title: List commands

tools.description: Execute one FigCraft command by id with JSON params (ids and params from list_commands). Mutating commands are one undo step each; a failing command leaves the document unchanged. Examples: {"command":"align.left","params":{"ids":[3,4]}}, {"command":"layout.add","params":{"ids":[2],"direction":"vertical"}}, {"command":"style.create","params":{"type":"paint","name":"Brand/Primary","from":5}}. Returns the command's result (creation commands return {"id"}). Programmatic calls never open dialogs.

command.description: Command id, e.g. node.create, align.left, component.create, file.export

tools.name: run_command
tools.title: Run command

tools.description: Run several commands in order as ONE undo step (engine `command.batch`). If any command fails, everything is rolled back and the error names the failing step. Returns an array of the results in order. A later step can use a layer an earlier step created: anywhere in its params, {"$step": n} stands for the `id` in step n's result (zero-based; {"$step": n, "field": "…"} picks another field). Example: [{"command":"node.create","params":{"type":"frame"}}, {"command":"node.create","params":{"type":"text","text":"Hi","parent":{"$step":0}}}] builds a frame and a text inside it in one call.
tools.name: batch
tools.title: Run commands as one step

tools.description: Create a layer (engine `node.create`) and return its id and inspected properties. Coordinates are page units, y down; x/y are relative to the parent frame (the page when there is none, so then they are page coordinates; groups don't count). Inside an auto-layout frame the position is decided by the layout. The new layer becomes the selection.

height.description: Height (default 100; ignored for lines/arrows and auto-height text)

index.description: Z-index among the parent's children (default: on top)

parent.description: Parent frame/group/component id (default: the current page)

path.description: SVG path data, for type vector (e.g. "M0 0 L100 0 L50 80 Z")

props.description: Any set_properties keys applied at creation, e.g. {"fill":"#3366FF","cornerRadius":12,"fontSize":24,"layout":"vertical","gap":8,"padding":16}

width.description: Width (default 100; text hugs its content unless width is set, which makes it wrap)

x.description: Left, relative to the parent frame (default 0)

y.description: Top, relative to the parent frame (default 0)

tools.name: create_node
tools.title: Create layer

tools.description: Set properties on one or more layers as one undo step (engine `node.set`). Keys: name, visible, locked, opacity (0-1), blend, x, y (relative to the parent frame; groups don't count), width, height, rotation (degrees), fill (colour) / fills (array of paints: "#hex" or {"type":"solid","color":"#hex"} or {"type":"linearGradient","stops":["#hex","#hex"]} or stops [{"position":0..1,"color":"#hex"}], optional from/to handles in the unit box; radialGradient too), stroke / strokes, strokeWeight, strokeAlign (inside|center|outside), cornerRadius (n or [tl,tr,br,bl]), effects (array, e.g. {"type":"dropShadow","color":"#00000040","offset":[0,4],"radius":8}), clip, layout (null|horizontal|vertical|grid), gap, padding (n or [t,r,b,l]), mainAlign (min|center|max|spaceBetween|spaceAround|spaceEvenly), crossAlign, wrap, contentAlign (auto|spaceBetween: wrapped lines), sizingH / sizingV (fixed|hug|fill), constraints {horizontal, vertical}, characters, fontFamily, fontStyle, fontSize, lineHeight, letterSpacing, textAlign, textAutoResize. Auto layout keys (gap, padding, mainAlign, crossAlign, wrap, …) apply to frames, components and instances only: other layers among the ids are skipped and named in `warnings`, and with none that can take them the call is an error. A fontStyle draws in the family's nearest face; `warnings` says when that face has another weight or slant than the name asks for. Run list_commands with filter "node.set" for the full list. Unknown keys are an error. Returns the updated layers.
tools.name: set_properties
tools.title: Set properties

tools.description: The active document as JSON: name, path, dirty flag, current page, selection, the current page's layer tree (id, name, type, x/y relative to the parent frame (groups don't count), width, height, absoluteBounds in page coordinates, fills, strokes, effects, cornerRadius, layout, sizing, text properties, component links, overrides, bound variables), other pages summarised, styles, variable count and the undo history. Use it to verify every change.

allPages.description: Expand every page, not only the current one

depth.description: Tree depth for the current page (default 4)

tools.name: inspect_document
tools.title: Inspect document

tools.description: One layer as JSON (same fields as inspect_document) with its children to `depth`.
tools.name: get_node
tools.title: Get layer

tools.description: Replace the selection with `ids` (switching to their page). An empty array deselects everything. Most commands act on the selection when no `ids` are passed.
tools.name: select
tools.title: Select layers

tools.description: Export layers (default: the selection, else every top-level layer of the current page) as png, jpg, svg, webp or pdf at `scale`, or the whole file as `fig` (experimental: written from public format knowledge, with `warnings` for what was left out; other apps may not open every file) (PDF: with `bleed`, `cropMarks`, `bleedMarks` and `cmyk` for print; options `contentsOnly`, `includeBoundingBox`, and for SVG `svgOutlineText`, `svgIdAttribute`, `svgSimplifyStroke`). With `path` the file is written there (absolute path recommended) and the result says where. Without `path`: png/jpg/webp come back as an image content block, svg as text, other formats as base64 `data`.

bleed.description: PDF: bleed around each page, in points or as a length like `3mm` or `0.125in`

cmyk.description: PDF: CMYK colour instead of RGB

contentsOnly.description: Only the layers themselves (default true); false also draws every other layer that shows in their area

format.description: Format (default png, or from the path's extension)

ids.description: Layers to export (several are composited into one image)

includeBoundingBox.description: Export the layers' own boxes, cutting off shadows and outside strokes (default false)

scale.description: Pixel scale for raster formats (default 1, max 64)

size.description: Instead of `scale`: `2x`, or a width or height in pixels like `512w` / `512h`

svgIdAttribute.description: SVG: layer names as unique `id` attributes (default false)

svgOutlineText.description: SVG: text as outlines (default true); false keeps `<text>` elements

svgSimplifyStroke.description: SVG: strokes as `stroke` attributes where exact (default true); false writes outlines

tools.name: export
tools.title: Export

tools.description: Look at the design: renders the given layers (or the whole current page, with its background) to PNG and returns it as image content, plus its size and the scale used. The image is scaled down to fit `maxSize` pixels. With `window: true` (or a window id from `inspect_ui`'s `windows`) and an attached app, captures that app window including the UI instead.

ids.description: Layers to render (default: the whole current page)

scale.description: Requested scale (default 1; reduced to fit maxSize)

window.description: Capture the app window: true for the one in front, or a window id (attached app only; headless renders the page)

tools.name: screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot

tools.description: Open a .figcraft or .json document (FigCraft or REST API file JSON), a .fig file (best effort, with `warnings` for what wasn't imported), an .svg (becomes vectors) or an image (becomes an image layer) as the active document. Returns the new document's summary.

variables.description: REST API file JSON only: the local variables JSON (`GET /v1/files/:key/variables/local`) as a path or the JSON object. Default: `<name>.variables.json` or `variables.json` next to the file.

tools.name: open_file
tools.title: Open file

tools.description: Save the active document as a .figcraft file. `path` is required the first time (an untitled document has no path); later saves reuse it. A `path` ending in .fig writes an experimental .fig export copy instead and leaves the document's own path and unsaved changes alone.

path.description: Output .figcraft path, or a .fig path for an experimental export copy

tools.name: save_file
tools.title: Save file

tools.description: Undo the last change (one command, batch or gesture). Returns {undone: bool}.
tools.name: undo
tools.title: Undo

tools.description: Redo the last undone change. Returns {redone: bool}.
tools.name: redo
tools.title: Redo

tools.description: Drive the canvas with the mouse in page coordinates, exactly as a user would with the current tool: click to select, drag to move/resize/marquee, or draw with a shape tool (set `tool` first, e.g. {"tool":"rectangle","kind":"drag","x":0,"y":0,"to":[200,100]}). `double` on a text layer starts editing it. Returns the selection and tool.

pressure.description: Pen pressure 0-1 (the Pencil records it as the stroke's width profile; a drag starts with it)

pressureTo.description: Pen pressure 0-1 at a drag's end (interpolated along it)

tools.name: pointer
tools.title: Pointer gesture

tools.description: Press a key or shortcut as if typed on the canvas: a menu shortcut (e.g. {"key":"G","cmd":true} groups, {"key":"A","alt":true,"shift":false} …), a tool key (R, O, T, F, V…), Escape, Delete, Enter, arrows (nudge; shift = big nudge). While editing text, keys go to the text editor (Backspace, Delete, Left, Right, Home, End, Enter, Escape, SelectAll).

key.description: Key name: a letter/digit, Escape, Delete, Backspace, Enter, ArrowLeft…

tools.name: key
tools.title: Press key

tools.description: Type into a text layer. With `id`, starts editing that layer with all of its text selected (so the typed text replaces it), types, then stops editing. Without `id`, types at the caret of the text currently being edited (after a double-click with pointer, or after drawing with the text tool).

id.description: Text layer to replace the contents of

text.description: Text to type (\n for a new line)

tools.name: type_text
tools.title: Type text

tools.description: UI state: current tool, view (zoom, centre), status, panels, timings and the app's windows (`windows`: id, title, files) when attached to the app; headless reports the session status.
tools.name: inspect_ui
tools.title: Inspect UI
